subject: Field Partner Capability Lab — curriculum & pilot plan
body:
From: Maya Patel <maya@catalystconsulting.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner enablement — interest in a hands-on capability lab

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the intro to Redwood's partner program at the conference last week. We loved the demo. Catalyst Consulting runs an AI practice that focuses on customer-facing integrations for enterprise SaaS; we'd like to pilot a hands-on capability lab for three of our solution architects to accelerate deal readiness.

High level ask: a 1.5 day in-person or remote lab that covers model selection for retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering for production, inference cost/levers (batching, quantization), and a short troubleshooting checklist for private deployments.

Can you share a sample curriculum and a rough SOW/time estimate? Also curious whether Redwood provides a partner certification track (simple badge for SAs) and whether you have any templated pilot SOWs.

Best,
Maya Patel
Director, AI Strategy
Catalyst Consulting

---

On Wed, 28 Mar 2028 at 10:05 AM, laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
To: Maya Patel <maya@catalystconsulting.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement — interest in a hands-on capability lab

Hi Maya — great to meet you at AI Con. Thanks for the clear scope. I've sketched a recommended 'Field Partner Capability Lab' curriculum and a pilot plan (attached). Top-level proposal below: 

- Audience: 3 Solution Architects (can expand)
- Format: 1 full remote day + half-day follow-up workshop (can convert to in-person)
- Goals: hands-on model serving runs, prompt+eval patterns, cost/perf tradeoffs, private deployment checklist, and a short certification assessment
- Deliverables: Lab slides & exercises, a Partner Certification exam (pass/fail + badge), pilot SOW template, and a post-lab action plan for customer pilots

Operational notes: Vivek will own lab environment provisioning (short-lived dedicated instances) and Camila will run the curriculum as lead instructor. Estimated effort for Redwood: 2 instructor-days + 8 hours for environment setup + certification authoring (4–6 hours). Pricing for pilot support: see attached Partner_Certification_Path.xlsx for tiered pricing options.

Next steps: if that aligns, can you confirm dates (we have openings the week of Apr 16 or Apr 30) and whether you want remote or on-site? I'll follow up with a formal SOW.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head, Solution Alliances | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

---

On Wed, 28 Mar 2028 at 11:18 AM, camila_reyes@redwood.ai wrote:
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Maya Patel <maya@catalystconsulting.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:18:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement — interest in a hands-on capability lab

Adding a few curriculum details from an enablement POV: 

Proposed agenda (remote):
09:00–09:30 — Introductions, objectives, pairing with Redwood demo tenant
09:30–11:00 — Inference fundamentals & model variants: practical selection heuristics
11:00–12:30 — Hands-on: deploy a small RAG pipeline (embedding index + retrieval code)
12:30–13:15 — Lunch
13:15–15:00 — Prompt engineering patterns, structured outputs & evals
15:00–16:00 — Cost controls: batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs; live comparison (metrics)
16:00–17:00 — Troubleshooting checklist + runbook (private deployment focus)
Follow-up 0.5 day: guided customer scenario lab + certification assessment

Exercise assets: short dataset (customer support transcripts), sample prompts, pre-built embedding index. We will keep infra short-lived and instrumented for token/cost telemetry.

Camila Reyes
Partner Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, 29 Mar 2028 at 08:02 AM, Maya Patel <maya@catalystconsulting.com> wrote:
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 08:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement — interest in a hands-on capability lab

Thanks — this looks excellent and aligned with what we need. A couple clarifying Qs before we lock dates: 
1) Certification: is the partner badge tied to seat completion or a short proctored exam? What is the pass threshold?
2) Pilot SOW: can Redwood include a clause for a 30-day extension of infra if our customer pilots run long?
3) Pricing: we prefer the mid-tier option but want an itemized add-on for on-site travel.

We can do Apr 30 (remote) — Evan and I are available. Please send the SOW and an invoice estimate and we'll start the PO.

Best,
Maya

---

On Fri, 30 Mar 2028 at 16:45:00 -07:00, laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
To: Maya Patel <maya@catalystconsulting.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement — interest in a hands-on capability lab

Maya — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers inline: 
1) Certification: partner badge requires passing a short proctored assessment (10 multiple choice + 2 live troubleshooting scenarios). Pass threshold: 70%. Seat completion without passing gets a 'participation' certificate only.
2) Pilot SOW: yes — we'll include a 30-day infra extension option (pre-approved cost per additional week).
3) Pricing: mid-tier + travel add-on; estimate attached. Invoice estimate and formal SOW attached (Pilot_SOW_template.docx).

Confirmed: Apr 30 (remote). Camila will send calendar invite and exercise assets by Apr 24. Vivek, please provision a 3-seat demo tenant and the short dataset; mark with project code CAT-0328.

Looking forward — Laura

Attachments referenced: FP_Capability_Lab_Curriculum_v1.pdf (lab slides & exercises), Partner_Certification_Path.xlsx (pricing & cert details), Pilot_SOW_template.docx (formal SOW template)
